nfc-keysets.postNfcKeysetsByIdRotate.description: Rotates a keyset to a new key version.

nfc-keysets.postNfcKeysetsByIdKeysByVers.description: Revokes a key version. Tags on it must be written again.

nfc-keysets.postNfcKeysetsByIdReenrol.description: Moves the tags of a keyset to another keyset.

nfc-keysets.postNfcKeysetsByIdImport.description: Imports supplier-personalised tags. Run it as a dry run first, then add.
